title: Reversible Bomber - Onyx Black
description: Features: Fabric: Colorado Fleece (Polyester/Spandex) Length: 19" from shoulder (XS) Side Pockets Description: The Reversible Bomber is a versatile cold-weather layer designed to deliver two distinct looks in one elevated essential. Crafted from our Colorado Fleece fabric, it features a smooth performance exterior with a soft brushed interior that provides warmth, comfort, and lightweight insulation for everyday wear. name: Strong Sports Bra - Guava
title: Strong Sports Bra - Guava
description: Features: Fabric: Poshknit (Nylon/Spandex) Support Level: Light Coverage Level: Medium Removable Bust Pads Adjustable Straps Multiway Strap Functionality (halter/keyhole, asymmetrical, or cross-back styling options) Description: The Strong Sports Bra is a versatile, lightly supportive sports bra designed for movement, comfort, and styling flexibility beyond the gym. Crafted in our signature Poshknit fabric, it offers an ultra-soft, double-brushed hand feel with a smooth, suede-like touch that feels elevated against the skin. Designed with a flattering medium-coverage silhouette and center front ruching, this bra delivers a feminine shape while maintaining a secure, comfortable fit for lower-intensity training and all-day wear. Removable bust pads allow for customizable shaping, while fully adjustable straps give you control over fit and support. What makes Strong truly stand out is its multiway strap design. Paired with the Served Waist Tank, this skort creates a stylish, coordinated set perfect for both the court and brunch.

name: Micro Legacy Legging - Tango and Grape Juice
title: Micro Legacy Legging - Tango and Grape Juice
description: Features: Fabric: NuBre (Nylon/Spandex) Compression Level: Light–Medium Rise: High Inseam: Short 24", Regular 26", Tall 28" Description: The Micro Legacy Legging is crafted from our exclusive Buffbunny Collection® NuBre fabric, a dreamy, double-brushed blend designed to feel like a second skin. Soft, supportive, and with high stretch retention, NuBre offers medium compression that moves with you, making it perfect for mobility workouts like Pilates, yoga, barre, or studio sessions, while remaining comfortable enough for everyday wear. This true high-rise legging fits at the natural waist for average-height women and is a favorite for petites. The micro butterfly tri-arch back waistband provides subtle contouring to accentuate the glutes, while the clean, no side seam and no front rise seam construction creates a sleek, uninterrupted silhouette. Sculpting, flattering, and versatile, the Micro Legacy Legging combines contemporary design with second-skin comfort for yoga, Pilates, barre, or effortless everyday style.
